project_kinds.name: Communauté d'énergie renouvelable
project_kinds.description: A renewable energy community: an entity of participants close to the renewable plants it owns or runs, sharing their energy (Wallonia, Brussels).

project_kinds.name: Communauté d'énergie citoyenne
project_kinds.description: A citizen energy community: an entity of participants sharing energy, without the proximity a renewable one requires (Wallonia, Brussels).

project_kinds.name: Communauté d'énergie locale
project_kinds.description: A local energy community of the Brussels-Capital Region.

project_kinds.name: Partage d'énergie / Energiedelen
project_kinds.description: Energy sharing between participants, inside one building or between a producer and its neighbours, without forming a community.
